note: B23 far end of the yard, Le hangar-musée: the old timber hangar turned into a small road museum (C1-C2 words), camera at the south end facing north. Weathered timber walls and trusses, high windows, plank floor, rope barriers on brass posts. Landmark: the tall glass display case (zoom R_road_04_z1 La vitrine). Feminine LEFT: cream vintage caravan with a family of rabbits waving from the window (caravane); hare leaping over a low wooden hurdle (traverse). Masculine RIGHT: black horse-drawn cab, shafts resting on the floor, badger coachman in a top hat on the box (fiacre); pale blue vintage coach with tortoises in sun hats at every window (autocar); mouse in a Roman helmet pushing an old wooden hand cart (chariot); raccoon peddler with a sooty face carrying pots, pans and ribbons on his back (colporteur). Exit: the big plank doors on the right -> back out to R_road_01_z2 (stream and footbridge visible). Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p4).
